trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%capacity%' OR text ILIKE '%mA h%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh/g%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, kind, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%capacit%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%g-1%' OR text ILIKE '%g−1%' ORDER BY page

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%specific%' OR text ILIKE '%charge%' OR text ILIKE '%discharge%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%mA%' OR text ILIKE '%deliver%' OR text ILIKE '%galvano%' OR text ILIKE '%capac%' ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT id, figure_id, statement, printed_text, quantity, value, unit FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%capac%' OR statement ILIKE '%mAh%' OR unit ILIKE '%ah%' OR statement ILIKE '%charge%' OR statement ILIKE '%specific%'
SELECT id, figure_id, line_no, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%ah%' OR text ILIKE '%capac%' OR text ILIKE '%mA%' OR text ILIKE '%g%'
